prompt: A geostationary object. Name the event, and the first action the governing procedure requires.
plot_description: Sub-satellite longitude against time. The trace saws between two bounds, drifting one way then being pulled back at a regular interval, with the mean longitude unchanged across the whole span.
accepted_first_actions: confirm in a second independent fit
confirm the change across two fits
expert_cue: The mean longitude does not move. Corrections are periodic and small, and each one returns the object to the same box. Repositioning changes the drift rate and holds the change.
